The '''Battle of Carbos Thirteen''' was fought during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. During the battle, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] trapped [[Confederation]] forces near [[Carbos Thirteen]].
